fishUnreachable: fish error: cannot reach Fish Audio ({reason})
voicePrefixMany: the voice prefix “{voice}” matches several: {list}; write more of it
voiceUnknown: unknown voice “{voice}”. Known: {list}, or a 32-character Fish voice id
tagUnknown: [{tag}] is not in Fish's list of tags (giggle/sigh/pouting and the like get guessed as “um/uh”)
tagNoSound: [{tag}] is not followed by a matching “{sound_tags}…”: the model may add a sound of its own
helpVoice: a voice name from the config (modules.media.voices) / or a Fish voice id (its first 6 or more characters will do)
helpMain: watch a video: its information, when the bullet comments peak, a sheet of nine stills, and a transcript of the first minutes
helpLang: language to transcribe: zh (default), auto (detect), en, ja…
sheetLine: Frames: %s (open it with view_image; left to right, top to bottom they are at %s)
transcriptLine:
Speech in the first %s (transcribed automatically; may contain mistakes):
%s
transcriptNone: (no speech heard: perhaps only music, or nobody talks)
wizardAbout: Sends voice messages in a voice of its own, and watches videos.
wizardHow: Needs a voice from Fish Audio and ffmpeg; its manual says how.
